name.description: The hosting domain whose state is being set.

state.description: Desired domain state. `active`: the domain is in active service and accepts new DID registrations (re-activating a disabled domain cancels any pending purge). `disabled`: existing DIDs remain readable for the host's grace period, but no new DIDs may be hosted under it. Declarative — requesting the state the domain is already in is an idempotent no-op.
